Utilities/Energy.titulo: Merger Value Hit a First-Half Record as Deal Sizes Grew
Utilities/Energy.descripcion: Global merger activity reached a record $2.6 trillion in the first half of the year as companies pursued larger acquisitions, while analysts expect dealmaking to broaden into smaller companies.
